isolation_tests: Stage A builder accepts only source_text; derive hash internally. Schema binding source-only. Request identical for same source across all sibling records, labels, prior outputs and audit mutations.
Synthetic added-source variant changes A source/hash despite unchanged candidate IDs.
Stage A request contains no record, record-derived metadata, coverage labels, oracle, prior outputs, reviews or defect hints. Test full recursively serialized body, not just user text.
Stage B uses byte-frozen validated inventory; changing raw response after freeze invalidates provenance. Same exact source and restored record hashes as A/prior record.

Stage B has no private expected fields, audits or sibling cases. Full source hash identical; operative projection equals exhaustive original fields(record) with every whole value intact, and original record hash binds it.
host_tests: Reject duplicate JSON keys at every depth, trailing text, NaN/Infinity/exponent overflow, wrong bindings and unrecognized schema fields.
A: reject zero/>64 units, duplicate/invalid IDs, absent dependency, self dependency/cycle, bad exact quote or occurrence, whitespace-only assertions, contradictory uncertainty_reason.
A failure, non-stop finish, overflow or refusal suppresses B with zero retry. B full actual body+1024 over40000 suppresses dispatch; keep A and charge reservation.
B: exact frozen ID keys all required/no extras; reject duplicate/missing/substituted keys and wrong inventory/source/record hashes.

Pointer must be exact operative whole-field allowlist member and resolve against original record; reject IDs, containers, evidence, coverage, source text, invalid escapes, out-of-range arrays and duplicate pointers.
Matched requires nonempty operative assertion and all dependencies matched. missing requires empty pointers. Source-uncertain inventory cannot match.
Unknown dependency propagates unknown; known incomplete dependency prevents match. Unknown/invalid/audit gaps dominate global eligibility but retain all defect findings.
A model self-completeness claim rejected as extra field. All matched never sets source completeness verified.
Use approved prior fixture oracles offline to test explicit supplied mappings and guards. Do not claim offline test generation proves model discovery; do not dispatch synthetic paid calls.

Inventory tuple codec preserves every field, order, empty values, repeated/overlapping quotes and Unicode; restore hash equals frozen A. Reject altered columns, widths, field types, dropped values, substituted hash and extra envelope keys.

Operative record equals recursive removal of only evidence/coverage from original; exhaustive 310-field pointer/value equality on WI. Original IDs and all relationship values retained. Reject any omitted operative field or altered value.

Span selectors: Unicode codepoints (including non-BMP and combining marks), overlapping/repeated quotes and retained occurrence must roundtrip exactly. Reject booleans, negative/reversed/empty/out-of-range spans, wrong occurrence/start, byte/UTF-16 offsets and changed source/hash. Canonical restored A must equal frozen A, not merely pass schema.
mapping_semantics: Existing mismatched source-unit oracle can correspond to missing or mismatched in R10 only after reviewing whether any operative assertion remains; full obligation is not matched in either case. Preserve original expected data.
